heading: Three ways to stay
intro: Three apartments for rent in a calm, friendly neighbourhood with a shared pool and internet included — perfectly placed between Jan Thiel and Mambo Beach, only 30 minutes from the airport. Book your next Caribbean adventure now.

apartments.name: Apartment 1
apartments.description: A bright, private apartment with access to the shared pool and an easy reach of the island's best beaches.
apartments.imageAlt: Apartment 1 living room opening onto the terrace

apartments.name: Apartment 2
apartments.description: Comfortable and calm, with the shared pool just outside and the warmth of the hilltop all around.
apartments.imageAlt: Apartment 2 balcony with seating and views over the hilltop

apartments.name: Apartment 3
apartments.description: A peaceful retreat with everything you need for a relaxing holiday, moments from the water.
apartments.imageAlt: Apartment 3 dining area and open kitchen
